question: P, Q and R can complete a piece of work in 10 days, 15 days and 20 days, respectively. If they work together, in how many days can they finish the same work?
solution:
Given:

A can do the work in 10 days

B can do the work in 15 days

C can do the work in 20 days

Formula used:

Work done = Time taken × Efficiency

Time taken ∝ 1/Efficiency

Calculation:

1st day work by A = 1/10

2nd day work by B = 1/15

3rd day work by C = 1/20

Total work completed in 3 days

⇒ 1/10 + 1/15 + 1/20

⇒ (6 + 4 + 3)/60 = 13/60

Time taken to complete the work

⇒ 60/13

⇒ 4(8/13)

**They finish the same work in 4(8/13) days.**
